scoring_justification: Phonon stability, AIMD energy drift, and HER activity are recomputed from raw arrays; elastic and magnetic compared to paper-reported values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for magnetic moments (paper Table 3)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3 – Magnetic moments for ground state of MS monolayers.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from Table 3: FeS M=1.42 (average of 1.47,1.37), S=-0.04; MnS M=±1.55 (~1.545), S=0; VS M=0, S=0.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual values reported in the paper.

phonon.description: Phonon dispersions for FeS, MnS, VS; each with q_points (array of arrays) and frequencies (array of arrays)

aimd_potential.description: AIMD potential energies for FeS_673K, VS_673K, MnS_300K; each with time_ps (array) and potential_energy_eV (array)

elastic_constants.description: 2D elastic constants c11, c12, c66 (floats) for FeS, MnS, VS

magnetic_moments.description: Magnetic moments for FeS, MnS, VS; each with M_moment_muB and S_moment_muB (floats)

her_gibbs.description: HER Gibbs free energies for FeS and VS; each with differential_dG_H (8 floats) and average_dG_H (8 floats)

outputs.description: Aggregated quantitative results: phonon dispersions, AIMD potential energies, elastic constants, magnetic moments, and HER Gibbs free energies.

output_contract.notes: The checker verifies dynamic, thermal, and mechanical stability criteria and HER activity by comparing these values to hidden paper references and physical thresholds.
